name: athena-graphs
description: Run complex work as explicit, inspectable agent graphs with branching, joins, review gates, and human checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Inspectable graph orchestration for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Turn a natural-language goal into a durable graph of specialized agent nodes. Branch independent work, join results, loop through review, pause for human input, and monitor every step without managing a CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use Athena Graphs to implement this task
Graph this work and pause before final approval
